reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering forage, hedges, minerals, fish, winter plants, honey, brewing crops, a horse tool, a combat ring, and peppers were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover dynamic honey names, crop timing and trellis behavior, mineral and botanical descriptions, item effects and gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Hedge_Description.source: A shaped bush that acts like a fence.
Hedge_Description.translation: Un tufiș tuns într-o anumită formă, care ține loc de gard.

Helvite_Description.source: It grows in a triangular column.
Helvite_Description.translation: Crește sub forma unei coloane triunghiulare.

Hematite_Description.source: An iron-based Mineral with interesting magnetic properties.
Hematite_Description.translation: Un mineral pe bază de fier, cu proprietăți magnetice interesante.

Holly_Description.source: The leaves and bright red berries make a popular winter decoration.
Holly_Description.translation: Frunzele și bobițele roșii aprinse alcătuiesc o decorațiune de iarnă populară.

Honey_Description.source: It's a sweet syrup produced by bees.
Honey_Description.translation: Un sirop dulce produs de albine.

Hops_Description.source: A bitter, tangy flower used to flavor beer.
Hops_Description.translation: O floare amară și înțepătoare, folosită pentru a aroma berea.

HopsStarter_Description.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 11 days to grow, but keeps producing after that. Grows on a trellis.
HopsStarter_Description.translation: Plantează-l vara. Crește în 11 zile, dar continuă să producă și după aceea. Crește pe un spalier.

HorseFlute_Description.source: Playing this flute will summon your horse. Only works outdoors.
HorseFlute_Description.translation: Dacă cânți la acest flaut, îți vei chema calul. Funcționează doar în aer liber.

HotJavaRing_Description.source: Greatly increases your chance to find coffee drinks when slaying monsters.
HotJavaRing_Description.translation: Mărește considerabil șansa de a găsi băuturi cu cafea când ucizi monștri.
